content.comment_body: I would appreciate assistance with connecting an Arduino to a [product_name] controller using Ethernet. I want to exchange both analogue and digital parameters between the Arduino and the [product_name]. I've installed the settimino.h library, but I'm uncertain about the correct TSAP and DB settings. I also need advice on configuring the [product_name] in [product_name] programming software.

If no other device is communicating with the [product_name], you can use TSAP 20.00 and DB1. For settings in [product_name] programming software: Go to Tools > Ethernet connection, enter the [product_name] IP information, and then add the Ethernet connection. If the [product_name] is configured as Server, you will have access; if it's Client, you'll need to configure the data exchange parameters. Hope this is helpful.
